lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-intensity, roughly circular white pixel clusters arranged in approximately five horizontal rows and twelve vertical columns posterior to the pectoral fin insertion point.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical and horizontal bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect to form anchor nodes for the primary high-luminance blobs, creating a distinctive checkerboard pattern on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient from high-luminance pixels on the dorsal surface to deep shadow on the ventral aspect of the ridge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible portion of the first dorsal fin displays a sparse, irregular distribution of high-luminance blobs against its darker silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: A small, dark, fusiform secondary silhouette (remora) is visible attached to the ventral surface immediately posterior to the pectoral fin's trailing edge.
